summary: Iteration 224 Supabase-wait redesign. Backend iso suites all pass: storage_dual216 35/35, storage_wait224 24/24, storage_fail215 13/13, pictures_iso220 66/66 (one flaky run with Mongo AutoReconnect, but only when run in parallel with the other suites; it passed when run on its own), phase1_iso221 17/17. New bridge API QA 10/10: health mode=waiting, machine storage_waiting list with waiting_minutes, storage_waiting_jobs, waiting book not in stuck, retry is owner-only (reviewer 403, anon 401/403), owner retry returns mode+woke. Bridge log confirms the job backoff grows 30s, 60s, 120s, 240s. UI QA (desktop 1920 + mobile 390x844) on the bridge. Supabase-down checks 40/41 (1 was my own test bug, now fixed): % bar text, wait note, row retry while down shows the still-down toast and the note stays, badge label 'Storage: Supabase ka intezaar', popover storage-retry-now, machine-storage-waiting line, machine-waiting-<id> item, machine-storage-retry button. No 'backup' wording. Upload dialog notice, Select PDF opens the file chooser (regression from iter 215 still OK), and upload-progress shows 'N% · ...'. A new PDF uploaded while down becomes its own waiting row. No overflow on mobile and no 5xx. Recovery: flag removed, then 'Abhi phir try karo' showed the toast 'Supabase wapas aa gaya. N ruka hua kaam phir chal pada'. The wait notes cleared and both waiting PDFs became mocks within about 5s. Writes were Supabase 3 / Emergent 0. Machine shows no waiting, stuck or failed books. The flag file was re-created afterwards. One real UI issue: the storage badge goes stale.

minor.issue: Any exception from sb_put becomes StorageWaiting, including permanent ones: 400 bucket missing, 401/403 bad key, 413 file larger than the Supabase limit. Such a file waits forever (backoff capped at 300s, attempts never used up) and is never shown as failed. Suggest: treat non-transient 4xx as StorageError (fail with a clear message), or raise an owner alert after N hours of waiting.

minor.endpoint: tejas/imports.py process_import + tejas/chapter_books.py process_book (code review only)
minor.issue: The re-run after a wait depends only on the in-process run_later(60s). After a server restart the record stays 'queued' with no sweeper until the owner clicks retry. wake_storage() / POST /api/admin/storage/retry does not wake these. They also have no backoff (every 60s forever). In process_import the render paths use a fresh token=uid() on every run, so each re-run after a wait can leave orphaned render PNGs in Supabase.
Waiting book entry has message 'Transfer complete. Validating the original PDF.' even though the original has not reached Supabase. This is misleading next to waiting_minutes.

After Supabase goes down again, mode stays 'supabase' until the next check or a failed write, which can take up to about 1 min because of the cache. This is by design, but it adds to the badge staleness below.

ui_bugs.issue: The badge only refreshes every 60s. The row button type-upload-wait-retry-<id> and machine-storage-retry call onChanged/onReload but do not reload the badge. Seen in testing: after a successful row retry, the badge still said 'Storage: Supabase ka intezaar' about 5s after recovery. In the other direction, it said 'Storage: Supabase' while a just-uploaded PDF row already showed the Supabase wait note. Fix: share the health state through a context or window event, and reload it with fresh=true after retryStorage() and when an upload row has storage_wait.

action_items: StorageBadge: refresh health (fresh=true) after any RetryStorageButton success and when upload rows show storage_wait, so the badge does not lag up to 60s behind the rows.
put_object: do not wait forever on permanent Supabase errors (401/403/404 bucket/413). Surface them as a failure or an owner alert.
imports/chapter_books: make the StorageWaiting re-run survive restarts (cron or sweeper picks up queued records with a storage wait message), and include them in wake_storage().
machine status: show a waiting-specific message for storage_waiting books.
critical_code_review_comments: put_object's broad `except Exception` around sb_put turns permanent config errors into endless waiting.
imports/chapter_books wait path is in-memory only (asyncio task). Restarts lose the re-run, and there is no backoff.
process_import uses a new render token on each run, which leaves orphan render files after storage waits.
jobs.run_job StorageWaiting branch looks correct: attempts preserved, backoff capped at STORAGE_WAIT_MAX, kick_later scheduled. wake_storage resets next_run_at and drains the active lanes.
server.py StorageWaiting handler is correct: admin/studio paths get 503 storage_waiting with Retry-After 30; students get vault_unavailable.

rca of the issue: Badge staleness: useStorageHealth is local state inside StorageBadge with a 60s interval. RetryStorageButton in UploadProgress/MachinePanel only calls onChanged/onReload of its own parent; only the popover's own button calls the badge load(). The server health is also cached (up to about 1 min) and only flips on a failed write or check.
